subject: Refund not received
body: I cancelled my subscription two weeks ago and was promised a refund, but I still have not received the money in my account. This is unacceptable.

subject: Question about my last invoice
body: Hi, could someone explain the extra line item on my October invoice? I don't recognize the charge.

subject: Downgrade my subscription plan
body: I would like to move from the Pro plan to the Basic plan starting next billing cycle please.

subject: URGENT billing error charged twice
body: You charged my card twice this month for the same subscription! Please fix this immediately, I need this resolved today.

subject: App crashes every time I open reports
body: Every time I click on the Reports tab the app crashes completely and I lose my session. This has been happening since the update.

subject: Entire platform is down for our team
body: None of our 40 employees can log in right now, the dashboard just times out. Production is completely down.

subject: API integration returning 500 errors
body: Our integration with your webhook API started returning 500 errors after your last deploy. Sample request attached.

subject: Minor UI glitch on settings page
body: Small cosmetic issue: the save button overlaps the label text on the settings page in dark mode. Not urgent.

subject: Can't reset my password
body: The password reset link in the email is broken, it just redirects to the homepage. I've been locked out for two days.

subject: Need admin permissions removed for a former employee
body: Please remove admin access for a team member who left the company yesterday, this is a security concern.

subject: Please delete my account and all data
body: I no longer wish to use the product. Please permanently delete my account and all associated data per GDPR.

subject: Two factor authentication not sending codes
body: I'm not receiving SMS codes for 2FA login, tried three times, can't get into my account at all right now.

subject: Would love a dark mode option
body: It would be great if the dashboard supported a dark theme, it's tough on the eyes at night.

subject: Add CSV export to the analytics page
body: Can you add a CSV export button to analytics? We currently have to screenshot everything which is painful.

subject: Suggestion improve search filters
body: Search filters could be more granular, maybe add a date range picker. Just a suggestion, loving the product otherwise!

subject: Feature idea Slack notifications
body: Would be awesome to get Slack notifications when a ticket is assigned to me instead of only email.

subject: How do I invite teammates
body: New to the product, trying to figure out how to invite my teammates to the workspace. Can you point me to docs?

subject: Great support experience recently
body: Just wanted to say your support team resolved my last two tickets super fast, really appreciate it!

subject: What are your business hours
body: Quick question, what time zone and hours is your support team available? Want to know when to expect replies.

subject: Overall very happy with the product
body: Been using this for six months now and it has genuinely improved how our team handles tickets. Thank you!

subject: Charged after cancelling account
body: I cancelled last month yet was billed again today. Please refund this immediately, very frustrated.

subject: Subscription upgrade question
body: If I upgrade to Enterprise mid cycle, do I get prorated billing or charged the full amount?

subject: Mobile app freezes on login screen
body: The iOS app freezes on the login screen after the latest App Store update, tried reinstalling with no luck.

subject: Database connection errors in integration
body: Our nightly sync job has started throwing database connection errors intermittently over the past three nights.

subject: Cannot access account after email change
body: I updated my email address and now I cannot log in with either the old or new email. Locked out.

subject: Request to export all account data
body: Could you send me an export of all my account data before I consider closing the account?

subject: Please add bulk ticket assignment
body: It would save us hours each week if we could bulk-assign tickets to agents instead of one at a time.

subject: Is there a public roadmap
body: Curious if there's a public roadmap so we can see what features are coming next quarter.

subject: Outage affecting checkout for customers
body: Our customers cannot complete checkout through your payment widget right now, this is costing us revenue every minute.

subject: Thank you for the quick fix
body: The bug I reported last week was fixed super quickly, appreciate the fast turnaround from the engineering team.
